# PaginationWrapperBase

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Shared behaviour for the single-child pagination primitives.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IContentContainer`, `IStatefulElement`.

## Properties

- [`Child`](#child): The element whose pagination this primitive governs.

The element whose pagination this primitive governs.

## Methods

- [`GetChildren`](#getchildren): Returns the wrapped child, or nothing when there is none.
- [`RenderStateful`](#renderstateful): Decides whether the child renders on the current page, then renders it and maps its status to the status this wrapper reports.
- [`ResetState`](#resetstate): Clears the continuation state of this wrapper and of its child.
